en.title: Lanterns Explains the Guardians of the Universe and Abin Sur's Legacy
en.summary: The new HBO series 'Lanterns' dives deep into the cosmic origins of the Green Lantern Corps. While the show focuses on John Stewart and Hal Jordan's dynamic, it also unpacks the lore behind the Guardians of the Universe and the pivotal role of Abin Sur.
en.body:
The premiere of **Lanterns** on HBO has thrown audiences headfirst into the vibrant, often bewildering, universe of the Green Lantern Corps. For many, this is their first deep dive into the intergalactic peacekeeping force, and the show’s creators are wisely laying the groundwork. At its heart, the series explores the foundational elements that make the Corps tick: the iconic power rings, the unwavering importance of willpower, and the enigmatic figures who set it all in motion.

Central to the narrative is the dynamic between **Hal Jordan**, the first human to wield a Green Lantern ring, and **John Stewart**, a promising recruit chosen by the universe itself. Their mentorship, often fraught with differing perspectives and the weight of expectation, serves as our entry point. As **Hal** explains to a young **John Stewart** in a flashback, the ring seeks those who possess an 'absolute lack of fear' – a core tenet of the Corps. This emphasis on inner strength is crucial, as the series aims to ground its fantastical elements in relatable human (and alien) struggles.

## The Architects of Order

The **Guardians of the Universe** are the ancient, immortal beings who founded the Green Lantern Corps. Hailing from the planet Maltus, these beings dedicated themselves to spreading order and goodness across the galaxy. Their creation, the Corps, acts as an intergalactic police force, patrolling the vast expanse of space and enforcing cosmic law. We've seen glimpses of their influence before, hinting at their long and storied history. The **Guardians** are the ultimate authority, entrusting their power rings to worthy individuals across countless sectors of the universe, each tasked with protecting their assigned territory.

> "In short, the Guardians are the founders of the Green Lantern Corps, immortal aliens determined to bring goodness into the galaxy."

## The Legacy of Abin Sur

A pivotal figure in the Green Lantern mythos, **Abin Sur** was the previous protector of Sector 2814, the sector that includes Earth. His crash-landing on our planet was the catalyst that brought the Green Lantern ring to **Hal Jordan**. The ring, a tool of immense power capable of manifesting anything the wearer can imagine, requires a recharge every 24 hours and draws its strength from the willpower of its user. **Abin Sur**’s story is not just about passing the torch; it’s about the ripple effect of his presence and actions that continue to shape the universe long after his time.

## What This Means for Fans

For long-time fans, the series offers a chance to see beloved characters and concepts brought to life with a new level of detail and cinematic scope. For newcomers, it’s an accessible gateway into a rich tapestry of cosmic lore. The show’s approach, blending a gritty, mystery-driven narrative with expansive sci-fi elements, promises to engage a broad audience. The tension between the **Guardians’** choices and the ring’s own selections highlights the complex politics and ancient history at play within the Corps, making the stakes feel incredibly personal for both **Jordan** and **Hal**.

## What's Next

As **Lanterns** continues, expect deeper explorations into the origins of the power rings, the homeworld of the **Guardians**, and the wider universe they govern. The series is set to unravel more mysteries surrounding the Corps' three-billion-year history and its place in the DC Universe.

es.title: Linternas: Descubriendo a los Guardianes del Universo y el Legado de Abin Sur
es.summary: La nueva serie de HBO, Linternas, nos sumerge en los orígenes cósmicos del Cuerpo de Linternas Verdes. Mientras la serie se centra en la dinámica entre John Stewart y Hal Jordan, también desentraña la leyenda detrás de los Guardianes del Universo y el papel crucial de Abin Sur. Con una narrativa que combina misterio y elementos de ciencia ficción, Linternas ofrece una visión fresca y emocionante del universo de DC.
es.body:
La premiere de **Lanterns** en HBO nos ha lanzado de lleno a un universo vibrante y a menudo desconcertante, el de las Linternas Verdes. Para muchos, esta es su primera inmersión profunda en la fuerza de paz intergaláctica, y los creadores de la serie están sabiamente sentando las bases. En su corazón, la serie explora los elementos fundamentales que hacen que el Cuerpo funcione: los anillos de poder icónicos, la importancia inquebrantable de la voluntad y las figuras enigmáticas que lo pusieron en marcha.

Central a la narrativa es la dinámica entre **Hal Jordan**, el primer humano en portar un anillo de Linterna Verde, y **John Stewart**, un recluta prometedor elegido por el universo mismo. Su mentoría, a menudo tensa con perspectivas diferentes y el peso de la expectativa, sirve como nuestro punto de entrada. Como **Hal** explica a un joven **John Stewart** en un flashback, el anillo busca a aquellos que poseen una 'falta absoluta de miedo' – un principio fundamental del Cuerpo. Este énfasis en la fuerza interior es crucial, ya que la serie busca fundamentar sus elementos fantásticos en luchas humanas (y alienígenas) relacionables.

## Los Arquitectos del Orden

Los **Guardianes del Universo** son los seres inmortales y antiguos que fundaron el Cuerpo de Linternas Verdes. Procedentes del planeta Maltus, estos seres se dedicaron a difundir el orden y la bondad a lo largo de la galaxia. Su creación, el Cuerpo, actúa como una fuerza policial intergaláctica, patrullando el vasto espacio y haciendo cumplir la ley cósmica. Hemos visto vislumbres de su influencia antes, insinuando su larga y llena de historias trayectoria. Los **Guardianes** son la autoridad última, confiando sus anillos de poder a individuos dignos en innumerables sectores del universo, cada uno encargado de proteger su territorio asignado.

> 'En resumen, los Guardianes son los fundadores del Cuerpo de Linternas Verdes, alienígenas inmortales decididos a traer bondad a la galaxia.'

## El Legado de Abin Sur

Una figura crucial en la mitología de las Linternas Verdes, **Abin Sur** fue el protector anterior del Sector 2814, el sector que incluye la Tierra. Su aterrizaje forzoso en nuestro planeta fue el catalizador que trajo el anillo de Linterna Verde a **Hal Jordan**. El anillo, una herramienta de inmenso poder capaz de manifestar cualquier cosa que el usuario pueda imaginar, requiere una recarga cada 24 horas y extrae su fuerza de la voluntad de su usuario. La historia de **Abin Sur** no se trata solo de pasar el testigo; se trata del efecto de onda de su presencia y acciones que continúan dándole forma al universo mucho después de su tiempo.

## Qué Significa Esto para los Fans

Para los fans de largo tiempo, la serie ofrece la oportunidad de ver a personajes y conceptos queridos cobrar vida con un nuevo nivel de detalle y alcance cinematográfico. Para los nuevos, es una puerta de acceso a una rica tapicería de leyendas cósmicas. El enfoque de la serie, que combina una narrativa de misterio y elementos de ciencia ficción, promete involucrar a una audiencia amplia. La tensión entre las elecciones de los **Guardianes** y las propias selecciones del anillo destaca la compleja política y la historia antigua en juego dentro del Cuerpo, haciendo que las apuestas se sientan increíblemente personales tanto para **Jordan** como para **Hal**.

## Próximos Pasos

A medida que **Lanterns** continúa, espere exploraciones más profundas sobre los orígenes de los anillos de poder, el hogar de los **Guardianes** y el universo más amplio que gobiernan. La serie está dispuesta a desentrañar más misterios que rodean la historia de tres mil millones de años del Cuerpo y su lugar en el Universo de DC.

content_raw: This article contains spoilers for Lanterns season 1 episode 1 . At the start of the pilot episode of Lanterns , a young John Stewart watches a television interview with Hal Jordan, the first human member of the Green Lantern Corps . Jordan talks a little about being a space cop, but for the most part, he focuses on the quality that makes him a suitable choice to join the Corps: his absolute lack of fear. The interview sets the model for the rest of the episode, in which Hal trains the adult John by mentioning a few details about the power ring and the importance of willpower, but leaves a lot of the sci-fi points unexplained. Given that Lanterns wants to appeal to a broad audience, the choice makes sense. The average HBO viewer will have an easier time accepting a True Detective -style gritty mystery with weird elements than it will a space opera. But those wanting more of the sci-fi stuff might come away frustrated that Lanterns only mentions strange aliens without really explaining who they are. If you want more alien fun, but don’t want to pour through decades of Green Lantern comics, be without fear: we’re here to explain it all. Guardians of the Universe In the pilot episode, the central tension between Hal and John comes down to the fact that the ring chose Hal when Abin Sur crashed on Earth (more on that in a moment) and that the Guardians of the Universe chose John. Devoted DCU fans might recall that we’ve heard reference to the Guardians before, when Guy Gardner confronted Superman midway through the latter’s first movie. In short, the Guardians are the founders of the Green Lantern Corps, immortal aliens determined to bring goodness into the galaxy. The Guardians originally hail from the planet Maltus, a peaceful world where its inhabitants discovered immortality and devoted themselves to scientific exploration. However, when a Maltusan called Krona wanted to witness the origin of the universe, he inadvertently introduced evil into the world. As penance, a group of Maltusans sought to contain the evil and protect potential victims, going through several methods before creating the Green Lantern Corps. That description makes the Guardians sound wise and benevolent, which is more or less how they were portrayed in the first years following their introduction in Green Lantern #1 (1960) by John Broome and Gil Kane. However, over the years, the Guardians have revealed themselves to be easily blinded by their own hubris and given to manipulation. In the comics, both Hal and John regularly butt heads with their bosses, which means that Hal’s skepticism in the show is well-founded. Green Lantern Corps As part of their mission, the Guardians divided the known universe into 3600 space sectors, covering all of space except for the lawless Vega System.
